scope: Type-IV receiving-tank thermodynamics with measured mass-flow and inlet-temperature boundaries
split_rule: lab_test_number modulo 3 equals 0 is validation; remaining eligible cases are calibration
claim_boundary: This is independent external component evidence for the receiving-tank model. It does not validate a station controller, cascade topology, dispenser, vehicle-side channels, ESD sequence or field safety.
goal_effect: Counts as the primary independent component-validation lane after the station-to-vehicle full-loop requirement was removed from the goal scope.
